name: VisEra Technologies Company Ltd.
summary: VisEra Technologies Company Ltd. engages in the research, design, manufacture, and sale of color filters, microlenses, image sensors, and micro-optical components and modules in Taiwan, the rest of Asia, the United States, and Europe. The company offers optical devices, such as image, light, optical fingerprint, and time-of-flight (ToF) sensors; and color filter and microlens, meta surface, silicon photonics, multi-film, nano-light-pillar, and special process technologies. It also provides process customization, optical simulation, integrated solutions, and wafer-level characterization, as well as wafer-level testing and optical thin film services.
